title: Song for Jit
identity: Tony Wheeler’s Song for Jit is an alto saxophone and piano work listed by the Australian Music Centre at about 5:50 and 13 pages plus part. AMC’s program note links its Sri Lankan inspiration with bebop, blues and Baroque elements; exact notation and intended audience remain unverified.

evidence.claim: AMC product page identifies edition, duration, instrumentation, and program note linking Sri Lankan inspiration with bebop, blues, and Baroque styles.
